summary: Conjugate the logarithmic derivative by the right factor and an explicit matrix K; the resulting map is block triangular in the chart coordinates, with blocks the Cayley Jacobians and the derivative of the section, whose determinants multiply to 𝗀(Z)^{k−1} times the Cayley densities.

steps.claim: k = |κ| ≥ 1 since k₀ ∈ κ: write k = k' + 1.

steps.lean: refine exists_symm_eq_chartCoords_skewOfReal.imp fun e ↦ .imp_right fun _ p ⟨hp@⟨_, _⟩, _⟩ ↦ ?_
steps.claim: Take e from exists_symm_eq_chartCoords_skewOfReal (e⁻¹ = chartCoords ∘ skewOfReal); fix p = (Z, θ, q, η, r) with Z ∈ Ω.

steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨_, hγ⟩, s⟩ := differentiableAt_sectionMatrix hp, hasStrictFDerivAt_snd (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := p)
steps.claim: sectionMatrix is real differentiable at Z (with derivative 𝒟), and the coordinate projections of p are strictly differentiable.

steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨a⟩, b, γ, d⟩ :=
    logDerivU_unipotentOf_mul_embedH (((skewColumnEquiv _).hasStrictFDerivAt.comp p (s.fst.prodMk
    (hasStrictFDerivAt_const ..))).prodMk s.snd.fst).hasFDerivAt,
    logDerivU_unipotentOf_mul_embedH s.snd.snd.hasFDerivAt, (hγ.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (gramSection_eventuallyEq hp)).comp p hasFDerivAt_fst, cornerDefect_pos hp; extract_lets F at b
steps.claim: a: the left factor p' ↦ u(q')·embedH(cayleyChart(1, skewColumnEquiv(k₀)(θ', 0))) is differentiable with the logarithmic derivative of logDerivU_unipotentOf_mul_embedH; b: the same for the right factor Φ(p') = u(r')·embedH(cayleyChart(1, η')); γ: p' ↦ (matrix of γ_{Z'}) has derivative 𝒟 ∘ (projection to Z) at p (gramSection_eventuallyEq); d: δ(Z) > 0.

steps.lean:
have h : DifferentiableAtU openCellChart p := (a.mul ⟨_, γ⟩).mul
    (by simpa only [Ring.inverse_unit] using! b.1.inverse ⟨_, rfl⟩)
steps.claim: h: openCellChart is differentiable at p (product of the left factor, γ_Z and the inverse of the right factor).
Let Δ = diagLast(δ(Z)^{−1/2}), R = 1 + F'_𝔰(F_𝔰 − F'_𝔰)ᴴ, M(A, B) = F((AΔ − 1)F_𝔰ᴴ + BΔF'ᴴ) and K = 1 + M(Z⁻¹, sectionCoeff(Zᴴ)).

steps.lean:
have : (gramSection p.1).1.1 * K = R + M (sectionCoeff p.1) p.1ᴴ⁻¹ := by
    simp +zetaDelta [coe_gramSection, *, mul_mul_eq_of_mul_eq (diagLast_sqrt_mul_inv _)]; abel
steps.claim: γ_Z·K = R + M(sectionCoeff(Z), Zᴴ⁻¹) (from the definition of sectionMatrix and diagLast(√δ)·diagLast(√δ⁻¹) = 1).
steps.typed_fact: (gramSection p.1).1.1 * K = R + M (sectionCoeff p.1) p.1ᴴ⁻¹

steps.lean:
have q v A B : besselTangent v * M A B = 0 ∧
    (M A B)ᴴ * besselTangent v = 0 := by simp [M, besselTangent]
steps.claim: q: besselTangent(v)·M(A, B) = 0 and M(A, B)ᴴ·besselTangent(v) = 0 for all v, A, B.
steps.typed_fact:
besselTangent v * M A B = 0 ∧
    (M A B)ᴴ * besselTangent v = 0

steps.lean: have t := abs_det_skew_congruence e.symm (F p * K) (skewCoords ∘ₗ logDerivU openCellChart p)
steps.claim: t: with C = Φ(p)·K, |det(e⁻¹ ∘ skewCoords ∘ (S ↦ CᴴSC) ∘ skewOfReal ∘ L)| = |det C|^{2r}·|det(e⁻¹ ∘ L)| for L = skewCoords ∘ logDerivU(openCellChart, p) (abs_det_skew_congruence).

steps.lean: generalize hT : (e.symm.1 ∘ₗ _ : End ..) = T at t
steps.claim: Call T the map on the left of t.

steps.lean:
have hT w : T w = _ := .trans (by simp [← hT, conjTranspose_logDerivU, *])
    congr(chartCoords (Kᴴ * $(sub_eq_of_eq_add (logDerivU_mul h b.1 w)) * K)).symm
steps.claim: hT: T(w) = chartCoords(Kᴴ·(logDerivU(openCellChart·Φ, p)(w) − logDerivU(Φ, p)(w))·K): by the product rule (logDerivU_mul) the difference is Φ(p)ᴴ·logDerivU(openCellChart, p)(w)·Φ(p), and skewOfReal ∘ skewCoords is the identity on skew-hermitian matrices (conjTranspose_logDerivU).

steps.lean:
simp [openCellChart, logDerivU_mul a ⟨_, γ⟩, *, F,
    (logDerivU.eq_1 ..).trans congr(_ ∘ₗ $γ.fderiv.1),
    mul_mul_eq_of_mul_eq (conjTranspose_mul _ K).symm, mul_mul_eq_of_mul_eq (q ..).2] at hT
steps.claim: Compute T(w): openCellChart·Φ is the left factor times γ_Z, so by the product rule its log-derivative is γ_Zᴴ·(left log-derivative)·γ_Z + (log-derivative of γ_Z); conjugating by K and using q, T(w) splits into the chart coordinates of the left factor's besselTangent part and of the section part.

steps.lean:
rw [det_mul, det_one_add_mul_comm, det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular, det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular,
    abs_mul, abs_mul, det_mulLeft_mulRight_real (p.1ᴴ⁻¹ *
    Δ)ᴴ (p.1⁻¹ * Δ), abs_det_logDerivU_col_eq_cayleyDensity, ← LinearMap.det_conj _ (.prodAssoc ..),
    det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular, det_mulLeft_mulRight_real 1 (cayleyChart 1 (skewColumnEquiv _
    (p.2.1, 0))).1.1, det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular 1, det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular
    (skewCoords ∘ₗ logDerivU (cayleyChart 1) p.2.2.2.1), det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular _ _
    (LinearMap.id.ext _), det_mulLeft_mulRight_real 1 (cayleyChart 1 p.2.2.2.1).1.1] at t
steps.claim: Determinants: det(C) via det(1 + AB) = det(1 + BA); T is block triangular, with the Z-block X ↦ (Zᴴ⁻¹Δ)ᴴX(Z⁻¹Δ) (determinant |det(Zᴴ⁻¹Δ)|^{2(ϱ+1)}|det(Z⁻¹Δ)|^{2(ϱ+1)}), the θ-block (the Cayley column Jacobian, cayleyDensity(1, skewColumnEquiv(k₀)(θ, 0))), the η-block (cayleyDensity(1, η)) and unitary blocks of determinant 1.

steps.lean:
simpa [abs_det_logDerivU_cayleyChart, mul_pow, pow_mul, Δ, diagLast, d.le, abs_of_pos, *,
    gramDiscReal_eq, prod_univ_castSucc, pow_add, field] using t.symm
steps.claim: Combining with |det Z|²δ(Z) = 𝗀(Z) (gramDiscReal_eq) and δ(Z) > 0 gives |det(e⁻¹ ∘ skewCoords ∘ logDerivU(openCellChart, p))| = 𝗀(Z)^{k−1}·cayleyDensity(1, skewColumnEquiv(k₀)(θ, 0))·cayleyDensity(1, η).

steps.lean: all_goals simp [*, K, chartCoords, Prod.mk_zero_zero, LinearEquiv.prodAssoc]
steps.claim: The side goals of the block decomposition reduce to identities of the coordinates (K, chartCoords).

steps.lean:
rotate_right; exact fun _ ↦ .trans (by simp [R, M, besselTangent]) congr(_ * (_ *
    ($(((mulLeftLinearMap .. ∘ₗ mulRightLinearMap ..).toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp _ hγ
    ).unique ((hasFDerivAt_id _).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (.of_forall (@frameCols_gram_sectionMatrix _)))) _ * _)))
steps.claim: The Z-block is the derivative of Z' ↦ F_𝔰ᴴ·J₁(𝔰)·sectionMatrix(Z')·F_𝔰, which is Z' itself (frameCols(𝔰)_gram_sectionMatrix), so its derivative is the identity (uniqueness of derivatives).

steps.lean:
all_goals simp [entrywise, @skewCoords.eq_1 𝔰.BesselIndex, inclMatrix, -re_sum, -im_sum, R,
    skewOfReal,
    sum_univ_castSucc, -Matrix.mul_sub, -Matrix.add_mul]; clear * -; simp [besselTangent,
    inclMatrix, mul_apply, -map_add] <;> first | (intros; simp [skewOfReal]; grind) |
    aesop (add simp skewCoords)
steps.claim: The remaining block-triangularity conditions are checked entry by entry (skewCoords, skewOfReal, besselTangent, inclusion matrices).
